meta.title: Leo Bastianelli — Full-stack developer
meta.description: Full-stack developer. Online stores, custom systems and automation for businesses that want to grow with the same technology large companies use.

contentMode.label: Switch between overview and technical detail

hero.intro: I started coding after watching small businesses get shut out of tools that large companies have used for years. That hasn't changed: I still think about how a business works and where the process breaks down before I think about which technology to use.
hero.introSecondary: These days that means working with clients across very different scales — from a hostel chain in Europe to an AI coaching app in the US — without losing that habit of asking what's actually needed first, not what's easiest to sell.

bioMore.p1: I'm a full-stack developer focused on product: React, Next.js, TypeScript, and the subscription and AI integration work I've been building lately for clients in Europe and the US.
bioMore.p2pre: Outside of client work, I play guitar in
bioMore.p2post: , a band from Córdoba blending shoegaze, trip-hop, and Argentine folk, and I build sim racing tools as a technical hobby — everything from race data analysis to computer-vision camera control.

personal.subtitle: Personal projects, no ship date — tools I build for my own sim racing setup.

contact.subtitle: Tell me how your business works today and I'll tell you what's worth building. I reply within 24 hours.
